baselineShortExecution.purpose: Improve effective sample size at deep nodes, keeping both training checkpoints fixed

baselineLongEarlierExecution.purpose: Improve effective sample size at deep nodes, keeping both training checkpoints fixed

limitations: One local Windows host; serial warm-cache process timings are not pure training or isolated old-node-phase timings.
Outside explicitly timed phases includes construction, checkpoint restore, hand export, JSON serialization and disposal; it is not pure initialization time.
Coverage uses each frozen policy own baseline trajectories. Different checkpoints change the distribution of visited histories.
Nested prefixes overlap; zero decisions mean unmeasured policy coverage; all-in runouts have no later decisions.
Only one training seed and a partial Simple K32/one-aggression postflop model; no full game equivalence or convergence certificate.
The chosen deep prefixes are heads-up continuations of a six-player game. Root counts alone do not isolate multi-player postflop pots.
The optional ordinary audit still uses 256 deviator traversals per seat and retains zero infosets; coverage-only results have no deviation gain.
